about.biography:
Hello! My name is Paul. I come from Argentina, which is a pretty good country. I am a very charismatic and friendly guy, believe me, those girls in the photo were convinced of this 😉. I don’t insult my own people; I have such principles.
Also, I am a creative person. Since childhood, I remember how my mother admired the way I drew a kitten from the street. 'Well, after this, son, you definitely need to study to be a designer.' And guess what?
That's exactly what I did. First, I signed up for a young artists’ club; I wanted to paint the Mona Lisa, but I didn’t have enough skills. And when he grew up, he moved to Amsterdam and took courses at IronHack.
There I found a pretty good team. At first I remember everyone was fighting, but then they got along very well with each other. The teachers there are also wonderful.
about.inANutshell: You won't get bored with him
